deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026; review starts in November and entry is fall only.
deadline.quote: The application deadline is December 1 each year, however we begin reviewing applications in November.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the official pages that could be fetched.

supervisor.value: Admission is by the PULSe committee; first-year students do lab rotations before choosing a lab.
supervisor.quote: Completed submissions will be reviewed by the PULSe Admissions Committee, which includes representatives from each of the PULSe Training Groups. | to allow them to complete core requirements and participate in laboratory rotations

funding.value: All admitted students, including international students, get paid tuition and an assistantship (stipend $33,000) in year one; later support from grants or assistantships at least matches it.
funding.quote: All students admitted to PULSe, both U.S. and international students, receive paid tuition and an assistantship for the entire first year of study | The PULSe Stipend is $33,000. | The level of support in subsequent years will meet or exceed the level of support provided in the student’s first year.

entry_route.value: Not stated; PULSe is doctoral only and expects a background in mathematics, biology and chemistry (including organic chemistry).

gre_general.quote: Beginning July 1, 2020, the GRE is not required for admission to PULSe.

notes: About 20 students enter each fall across nine training groups (e.g. Cancer Biology, Integrative Neuroscience, Biomolecular Structure & Biophysics). Choose 'Life Science Interdisciplinary Program' on the application.
name: Purdue University Interdisciplinary Life Science Program (PULSe)
